item.text:
The report now contains six reproduced findings: [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

The two new findings from this continuation are:

- **Digest/snapshot flag incompatibility (F5).** A snapshot written with digest enabled cannot be restored after disabling only `zookeeper.digest.enabled`; [FileSnap.deserialize](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/persistence/FileSnap.java:88) skips the digest record without consuming it, then reads the digest bytes as `lastProcessedZxid` and fails with CRC corruption. The reverse transition also fails with `Unreasonable length`. Repros: [DigestToggleRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/digest_toggle/DigestToggleRepro.java) and [DigestToggleReverseRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/digest_toggle_reverse/DigestToggleReverseRepro.java).

- **`TRUNC(0)` retains data (F6).** [FileTxnLog.truncate](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/persistence/FileTxnLog.java:481) leaves the first transaction in a non-empty log. The production [ZKDatabase.truncateLog](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/ZKDatabase.java:611) path also reloads existing snapshots, so both snapshot and log data remain. A mocked [LearnerHandler](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/LearnerHandler.java:858) reproduction confirmed that the leader selects `TRUNC(0)` when its committed view is empty and a follower is at zxid 8. Repros: [TruncateZeroRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/truncate_zero/TruncateZeroRepro.java), [TruncateZeroDbRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/truncate_zero_db/TruncateZeroDbRepro.java), and [TruncateZeroProtocolRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/truncate_zero_protocol/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/TruncateZeroProtocolRepro.java).

The earlier findings remain documented: rejected-snapshot state leakage, zero snapshot-size division, non-terminating oracle revalidation, and the 3+ voter oracle election bypass. All reproduction commands and observed outputs are preserved under `repro/`; the captured source itself remains unchanged.
